{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows negative sentiment (e.g., -0.25 or 0.50) as it signals market pessimism.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility in early periods (e.g., first 5-7 days) when price is trending downward, as models tend to overreact.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast is > 10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-10%.",
    "Cap forecast spikes above 10% above historical max in 15-day window to prevent overshoot.",
    "If sentiment turns positive (e.g., 0.50) after a dip, slightly increase forecast by 2-5% to capture momentum.",
    "For long-term (30-day) forecasts, reduce early peaks (first 10 days) by 5-10% to account for lag in market response.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast, apply a downward bias correction of 3-5% for next period."
  ]
}
